videos.title: The GTA 6 Hacker Just Pleaded Guilty 🚨 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the 2022 GTA 6 footage leak, pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court on Nov 16. Rockstar told the court the breach cost about $5 million, and sentencing is set for Nov 23.

Sources: UK Crown Prosecution Service, Kotaku, TechSpot, TweakTown

videos.title: Get a FREE Vice City Theme on Discord Before It's Gone 🌴 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Discord and Rockstar launched a free Vice City color theme, app icon and display name style on Nov 16. It's free for everyone until Dec 13; Nitro members reportedly keep it until Feb 20, 2027.

Sources: Discord (X), Dexerto, Beebom, Final Weapon

videos.title: So When Is GTA 6 Coming to PC? Here's What We Know 💻 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
GTA 6 launched Nov 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only, and Rockstar hasn't announced a PC date. Based on past Rockstar gaps (RDR2 ~13 months, GTA 5 ~19 months), late 2027 or 2028 is only a guess.

Sources: Rockstar Games, Windows Report, GamingBible, PCGamesN
